verdict.rationale: The evidence does not show MailerLite offering recurring schedules for jobs or workflows. Campaign scheduling (docs-9) is a one-off scheduled send, and abandoned-cart automations (docs-11) are event-triggered rather than recurring. Recurring payments (docs-26) and third-party app automation (docs-24) are adjacent features, not recurring job scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
